h.select_rule: Discard any hypothesis whose condition is the edited field's own current value, or whose condition merely disables or disconnects the edited component. From the rest, keep 10 with distinct mechanisms and field pairs, favouring those where an informed expert could plausibly bet on either direction.
h.strategy: Two patterns are banned because experts find them obvious: (1) conditioning on the current value of the same field being edited, which just restates that upgrading a weak setting helps more than upgrading a strong one; (2) conditions that make the edited component unused, unreachable or inert. Instead, each hypothesis must link two DIFFERENT fields that interact through a non-trivial mechanism, such as substitution between parallel routes, a capacity already supplied elsewhere, one part acting as a bottleneck for another, or interference that turns a usually helpful edit harmful. No condition setting may appear in more than two hypotheses. Use the gaps and negated assumptions as the source of each idea. In each 'why', name the mechanism and explain why the opposite direction is also a priori plausible.

hyps.why: With edge 5 already removed, the direct edge and edge 4 are the only routes to the output, so deleting edge 3 is more damaging and risks disconnection.
With edge 1 removed, node 2 is fed only via the 0->1->2 chain, so edge 5 carries less and pruning it costs less.
With no direct input to node 2, edge 2 becomes its sole feeder, so a strong conv there matters more.
Without the direct 0->3 edge, edge 4 is a main route to the output, so upgrading it to a 3x3 conv gains more.
Without the direct 0->3 edge, edge 5 is a main route to the output, so a stronger conv there gains more.
When node 3 already gets a 3x3 conv from node 1, a second one from node 2 brings diminishing returns.
When node 3 already gets a 3x3 conv from node 2, upgrading edge 4 adds redundant capacity with diminishing returns.
A strong conv already feeds node 3 from node 1, so the added direct conv is partly redundant and gains less.
With edge 4 removed, edge 0's influence reaches the output only through the longer 1->2->3 route, so its upgrade matters less.
A direct 3x3 conv from the input already supplies node-3 features, so removing the 2->3 route costs less than when edge 3 is weak.
